description: Reports & Expenses: Implement sales reports (today, yesterday, week, month, custom range), profit calculation using COGS from sale_items, inventory reports (current stock, low stock, expiring, expired), customer debt report, expense recording, and net profit calculation (revenue - COGS - expenses).
steps: Create src/services/repositories/expenseRepository.ts. Methods: getAll(filters?: {category?, startDate?, endDate?}), getById(id), create(data: {category, description, amount (in minor units), paymentMethod: PaymentMethod, notes?}), update(id, data), delete(id). Categories: 'Rent', 'Utilities', 'Salaries', 'Transport', 'Marketing', 'Other'.
Create src/hooks/useExpenses.ts with TanStack Query hooks: useExpenses(filters?), useExpense(id), useCreateExpense(), useUpdateExpense(), useDeleteExpense().

Create src/services/reports/salesReports.ts utility module. Export functions: getSalesReport(startDate, endDate) returning {totalSales: number, totalRevenue: number (sum of sale.total), totalCOGS: number (sum of sale_items.cost_of_goods_sold), grossProfit: number (revenue - COGS), totalCash: number (sum of payments where method=CASH), totalMobileMoney: number, totalCredit: number, topProducts: {productId, productName, quantitySold, revenue}[]}. Use executeQuery to aggregate from sales, sale_items, payments tables with date filtering (created_at >= startDate AND created_at < endDate).

Add helper functions to salesReports.ts: getTodaySales() calling getSalesReport(getStartOfDay(), getEndOfDay()), getYesterdaySales() using subtractDays, getWeekSales() (last 7 days), getMonthSales() (last 30 days). Use datetime utils.

Create src/services/reports/inventoryReports.ts. Functions: getCurrentStock() returning products with current_quantity and value (current_quantity * purchase_price), getLowStockProducts() calling productRepository.getLowStock(), getExpiringProducts(days=30) calling stockBatchRepository.getExpiringBatches(), getExpiredProducts() calling getExpiredBatches().
Create src/services/reports/debtReports.ts. Function: getCustomerDebtReport() returning customers with current_balance > 0, sorted by balance DESC, with total outstanding debt sum.

Create src/app/(tabs)/reports.tsx screen. Tabbed interface (or sections): Sales, Inventory, Expenses, Customers. Sales tab: date range picker (Today/Yesterday/Week/Month/Custom with start-end date pickers). Display: Total Sales count, Revenue (formatCurrency), COGS, Gross Profit, breakdown by payment method (Cash/Mobile/Credit). Top Products list. Use getSalesReport with selected date range. Inventory tab: Summary cards for total products, low stock count (link to list), expiring count (link to list), out of stock count. Current stock value. Expenses tab: date range picker. List of expenses with category, description, amount. Total expenses sum. FAB to add expense. Customers tab: list of customers with debt, showing name and balance. Total debt sum.

Create src/app/(tabs)/reports/sales-detail.tsx screen for detailed sales with date range, showing individual sale records in list: receipt number, date/time, total, payment methods. Tap to view sale details (receipt).

Create src/app/(tabs)/expenses/add.tsx screen for recording expenses. Form: category dropdown, description input, amount input (convert to minor units), payment method radio, notes. Use React Hook Form + Zod. Call useCreateExpense mutation. Navigate back on success.

Update Dashboard (src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx) to show key metrics: Today's sales revenue (from getTodaySales()), Today's transactions count, Today's gross profit, Outstanding customer debt total (from getCustomerDebtReport()). Use formatCurrency for all amounts.
acceptance_criteria: ExpenseRepository provides CRUD operations for expenses with category filtering
getSalesReport() aggregates sales data for date range: revenue, COGS, gross profit, payment method breakdown, top products
Date range helper functions (getTodaySales, getYesterdaySales, etc.) use datetime utils correctly
Inventory reports return current stock value, low stock, expiring, and expired products
Customer debt report returns customers with balance > 0, sorted by balance DESC, with total debt
Reports screen has tabbed/sectioned UI for Sales, Inventory, Expenses, Customers
Sales report shows date range selector, key metrics, payment breakdown, top products list
Inventory report shows summary cards with counts and navigation to detail screens
Expenses can be recorded with category, description, amount, payment method
Dashboard displays today's metrics: sales revenue, transaction count, gross profit, outstanding debt
All amounts displayed with formatCurrency, all storage in minor units
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and npx expo lint to confirm no errors
Complete 2-3 sales with different payment methods (cash, mobile money)
Navigate to Reports tab, select 'Today' date range, verify sales report shows correct revenue, transaction count, payment method breakdown
Verify gross profit = revenue - COGS (check that COGS is calculated from sale_items.cost_of_goods_sold)
Check top products list shows products from today's sales with quantities
Switch to Inventory tab, verify low stock count matches productRepository.getLowStock().length
Navigate to Expenses section, add expense for 'Rent' category with 50000 (KSh 500.00), verify it appears in expense list
View expenses report with custom date range, verify filtering works
View Customers tab in reports, verify only customers with balance > 0 appear, sorted by debt amount DESC
Return to Dashboard, verify today's metrics update after new sale: revenue increases, transaction count increments
Compare dashboard gross profit with reports sales tab gross profit, verify they match
Enable airplane mode, record expense, verify it works offline
